body:
## Highlights

This release mainly fixes regressions in 2.1.25, and makes downloads more resilient against transient network failures or overloaded servers.

* **`coursier.jar` and the thin `coursier` launcher work again.** In 2.1.25, these launchers bundled or pulled a Scala 2.13 `cats-free` next to the Scala 3-built CLI, so every resolution command (`fetch`, `resolve`, `launch`, …) failed with `NoSuchMethodError: cats.implicits$.catsStdInstancesForList()`. The stray 2.13 dependency is now gone. CI now also builds and tests JAR launchers, and rejects class paths that mix Scala binary versions. Fixes #3865. (#3879)
* **No more duplicate conflicts.** Since 2.1.25, a dependency declared as explicitly non-optional (`optional0 = Some(false)`, as sbt does) and the same dependency with no optional flag were treated as two dependencies. That duplicated entries in `minDependencies` and in `coursier.graph.Conflict(…)`, which broke sbt eviction warnings, for example. They are now normalized. Fixes #3861. (#3878)
* **The Scala 3 artifacts target Scala 3.3 LTS.** In 2.1.25 they were compiled with Scala 3.9.0, so only projects on 3.9 could use them. They are now built with 3.3.8, which makes them usable from any Scala 3.3+ project. (#3856)

## Downloads and cache

* **HTTP errors are retried with curl-style backoff.** The server responses that curl's `--retry` retries are now retried too: 408, 500, 502, 503, 504, and Cloudflare's 522/524. The first retry waits 1 second, and the wait doubles each time, up to 10 minutes. A `Retry-After` header on any of those responses is honoured, not only on a 503. Other 5xx responses, such as 501, fail right away. Connection errors, timeouts, and SSL errors keep their short backoff (10 ms, doubling, up to 20 s). The new `coursier.http-retry-backoff-initial-delay` and `coursier.http-retry-backoff-max-delay` properties tune this. See the [retries documentation](https://get-coursier.io/docs/other-retries). (#3884)
* **The CLI retries downloads by default.** `--retry-count` used to default to 1, so the CLI made a single attempt even when the cache would have retried. It now uses the cache's default (5 attempts, or the `coursier.exception-retry` Java property). Its help message also says that it covers network and server errors, not just checksum errors. (#3883)
* **Cache servers are used automatically.** When `COURSIER_CACHE_SERVER` points at a cache server, any `FileCache` using the default cache location now goes through that server. Before, only the default cache did. Local `file:` URLs are still read directly. The server also honours the client's cache policies and TTL. (#3887)
* **Local archives are left alone.** The archive cache no longer writes integrity files next to local archives that stay outside the cache (`file:` URLs), and no longer deletes them when they are corrupted. (#3885)

## CLI and installation

* `cs update` now shows versions, e.g. `Updated scalafmt (3.9.5 -> 3.9.6)`. (#3889)
* The Homebrew formula no longer depends on `openjdk`. That formula's `java` was on the `PATH` and shadowed the JVMs managed by coursier, so `java` and `cs java` could disagree. The native `cs` launcher doesn't need a JVM. The JAR-based `coursier` launcher uses the JVM from `JAVA_HOME` or the `PATH`, which `cs setup` can install. Shell completions now refer to `cs`. Fixes #3763. (#3886)

## Library changes

* **Scala 3 compiler crashes fixed.** Some GraalVM-only classes carry annotations that reference GraalVM classes users don't have on their class path. When one of those classes sat in a package user code looks up, the Scala 3 compiler could crash. They now live in dedicated packages:
  * `coursier.exec.Graalvm*` moved to `coursier.exec.graalvm`.
  * The deprecated, unused `coursier.jvm.GraalvmErrnoExtras` and `coursier.jvm.GraalvmUnistdExtras` were removed.
  * `coursier.cache.internal.SigWinchNativeWindows` moved to `coursier.cache.internal.graalvm`.

  These are native-image internals, but they are binary-incompatible changes. (#3857, #3862)
* **Future lazy vals in the Scala 3 artifacts.** They are compiled with `-Yfuture-lazy-vals`, the lazy val implementation that became the default in Scala 3.8 and works on JDK 25+. (#3866)
* **Separate jsoniter-scala versions.** The Scala 3 modules now use jsoniter-scala 2.41.0. The Scala 2 modules stay on 2.13.8, the last release with Java 8 class files. (#3855, #3877)
* **Scala.js artifacts are Scala 3 only.** The `_sjs1_2.13` artifacts are no longer published. (#3854)
